question: You are in a road accident and someone is hurt. What is the first thing you do?
options: Call for medical help and police, and help the injured if you can
explanation: If anyone is hurt, call for an ambulance and the police at once and take reasonable steps to get the injured person to a doctor.

en.question: You are in a road accident and someone is hurt. What is the first thing you do?
options: Call for medical help and police, and help the injured if you can
en.explanation: If anyone is hurt, call for an ambulance and the police at once and take reasonable steps to get the injured person to a doctor.

hi.question: आप सड़क दुर्घटना में हैं और कोई घायल है। आप सबसे पहले क्या करते हैं?
options: दूसरे चालक से बहस करते हैं
चिकित्सा सहायता और पुलिस को बुलाते हैं, और हो सके तो घायल की मदद करते हैं
hi.explanation: अगर कोई घायल है, तो तुरंत एम्बुलेंस और पुलिस को बुलाएँ और घायल व्यक्ति को डॉक्टर तक पहुँचाने के लिए उचित कदम उठाएँ।

question: The driver must report an accident that injured someone or damaged property to the nearest police station:
options: As soon as possible and within 24 hours
Never, if the owner is not found
explanation: Section 134: report as soon as possible and in any case within 24 hours.

en.question: The driver must report an accident that injured someone or damaged property to the nearest police station:
options: As soon as possible and within 24 hours
Never, if the owner is not found
en.explanation: Section 134: report as soon as possible and in any case within 24 hours.

hi.question: जिस दुर्घटना में किसी को चोट लगी हो या संपत्ति को नुकसान हुआ हो, चालक को उसकी सूचना नज़दीकी पुलिस थाने में देनी होती है:
options: जितनी जल्दी हो सके और 24 घंटे के भीतर
कभी नहीं, अगर मालिक न मिले
hi.explanation: Section 134: जितनी जल्दी हो सके और किसी भी हाल में 24 घंटे के भीतर सूचना दें।

sourceDoc: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended; India Code text) - s. 134

question: After an accident you should inform:
options: The insurance company, in writing, with the policy number, time and place
explanation: Section 134 also requires the driver to give the insurer written details of the accident.

en.question: After an accident you should inform:

hi.question: दुर्घटना के बाद आपको सूचना देनी चाहिए:

question: After a minor accident you may move the vehicles out of the way of traffic and switch on the hazard lights.

question: If there is no friendly agreement with the other driver after an accident, you should:
